statements.text: ADD-03:2.4 requires the temporary works for method (a) to pass, at each tie-in point, the maximum transfer flow stated for that tie-in point in Table 1-3. Table 1-3 (ADD-03 page 5) has these columns only: Tie-in point, Location, Existing sewer diameter (mm), Permitted shutdown window, Maximum shutdown duration (hours) and Advance notice. It has no transfer-flow column.

evidence.words: the maximum transfer flow stated for that tie-in point in Table 1-3

statements.text: The response to Q20 sets the design flow for the temporary works by the same reference to Table 1-3 and applies Section 2.4.

evidence.words: The temporary works shall be capable of passing the maximum transfer flow stated for each tie-in point in Table 1-3 at Appendix A to this Addendum. Section 2.4 of this Addendum applies.

statements.text: ADD-03:2.5 requires a Shutdown Acceptance Letter in Envelope A where method (b) is elected. Applications must be made not later than eight (8) Working Days before the Proposal Due Date. The Network Operator has undertaken to respond within five (5) Working Days. Counting 8 Working Days back from the PDD in VOL-I 6.1 as amended (Thursday 26 November 2026), with the PDD itself not counted, gives Monday 16 November 2026 (VOL-I 2.4 calendar, conservative reading).

evidence.words: Applications for a Shutdown Acceptance Letter shall be made to the Network Operator not later than eight (8) Working Days before the Proposal Due Date.

statements.text: ADD-03:2.5 states no consequence of its own for a missing Shutdown Acceptance Letter. ADD-03:2.6 deems an election of method (a) instead. Whether the Envelope A non-responsiveness rules (VOL-I 6.2, ADD-02 7.2) have any bearing is a human decision; no consequence is proposed.

evidence.words: shall be deemed to have elected method (a) for that tie-in point

statements.text: ADD-03:2.7 rejects a Proposal whose interruption of flow is longer than the maximum shutdown duration in Table 1-3. For TP-2, Table 1-3 states a permitted window of 01:00 to 05:00 (4 hours) and a maximum shutdown duration of 6 hours, so the two figures differ.

evidence.words: for longer than the maximum shutdown duration stated for that tie-in point in Table 1-3 shall be rejected

statements.text: The response to Q17 says Clause 12.3 is 'amended accordingly' but prints no replacement wording. VOL-V:12.3 at ADD-03 still reads that the Independent Engineer's costs are borne equally.

evidence.words: No. The reasonable costs of the Independent Engineer attributable to any reliability run after the first shall be borne by the Project Company. Volume V Clause 12.3 is amended accordingly.
whose reasonable costs shall be borne equally by the parties

statements.text: The response to Q18 refers to Volume V Clause 34. The Relief Event list in VOL-V 34.2 does not name a shortfall in network inflow, and VOL-V 34.1 gives an extension of time but not compensation.

evidence.words: The Authority notes the question. Volume V Clause 34 applies. The Authority does not consider further amendment necessary at this stage.

Relief Events comprise: fire, explosion, flood or other physical damage not caused by the Project Company; failure of a utility not caused by the Project Company; blockade or embargo; and official strike other than one confined to the Project Company or its subcontractors.

statements.text: The response to Q19 requires the asset register to be submitted before the start of the reliability run. VOL-II 7.4 says not later than sixty (60) days after PCOD. Q19 also refers to the CMMS 'required by Volume II Clause 8.2', and ADD-03/4.1(b) deletes Clause 8.2.

evidence.words: The asset register shall be maintained in the computerised maintenance management system required by Volume II Clause 8.2 and shall be submitted to the Authority before the start of the reliability run under Volume II Clause 7.2.

payload.why: ADD-03:2.5 adds a conditional Envelope A submission (a Shutdown Acceptance Letter where method (b) is elected) with an application deadline of 8 Working Days before the PDD. On the conservative count this is Monday 16 November 2026, a computed value, not a printed one. The provision states no bid-out consequence; ADD-03:2.6 deems method (a) instead. Whether the Envelope A rules VOL-I-6.2-02 or ADD-02-7.2-01 apply is a person's decision. No consequence is proposed.

evidence.words: Where the Bidder elects method (b) for a tie-in point, it shall submit with Envelope A a letter from the Network Operator accepting the Bidder's proposed shutdown programme for that tie-in point (a Shutdown Acceptance Letter).

evidence.words: A Bidder that elects method (b) for a tie-in point but does not submit a Shutdown Acceptance Letter for that tie-in point with Envelope A shall be deemed to have elected method (a) for that tie-in point.
